prev_agent: The cleanest integration point is your “OTHER IDEA”: LLM calls happen outside rules, listen to simulation events, and emit/display flavor only. That avoids making scheduler ticks async and keeps the LLM out of canonical state. I would draw the line like this: **Best First Integration** Use `npc:dialogue` as the seam, but do not replace canonical dialogue. Flow: ```text rules system emits npc:dialogue with deterministic fallback text + context main/display/cloud flavor enhancer optionally asks AI for a variant speech bubble displays AI text if it arrives in time, otherwise fallback nothing writes back to ECS state ``` Example payload shape: ```js world.emit("npc:dialogue", { actor, targetId, text: "The well's been strange lately.", source: "townfolk:ambient", flavorPrompt: { kind: "npc_speech", speakerRole: "barkeep", listenerRole: "player", topic: "rumor", weather, phase, townState, }, }); ``` Then `main/wiring/speechBubbleWiring.js` could optionally do: ```js const fallback = line; queue fallback immediately or after a tiny grace window; AI.complete({ messages, temperature: 0.8, maxTokens: 32 }) .then((generated) => { if (!generated) return; queueSpeechBubble({ entityId: speakerId, text: generated }); }); ``` I would probably not delay the game waiting for AI. Either show fallback immediately and let generated lines appear as extra ambient chatter later, or use a very small presentation-only timeout like 150-300ms before falling back. **Why Not Deity Actions First** “LLM output is an action string” sounds tempting, but it crosses the line faster. Even if the action set is one-dimensional and validated, the LLM is now influencing canonical simulation outcomes. That means determinism, replay, tests, saves, and balance all get complicated. A safer deity version would be: ```text rules chooses deity action deterministically LLM only writes the deity's spoken explanation ``` So canonical: ```js { action: "smite", targetId, damage: 7 } ``` LLM flavor: ```txt "Your oath rings hollow beneath my altar." ``` **Player Speaking With NPCs** I agree with …
